name: NPC Beastmaster
description: Pets for every class via the White Fang NPC (or .beastmaster).

keys.label: Enable the Beastmaster NPC
keys.explain: Master switch for the Beastmaster NPC that lets classes tame, stable and use hunter pets.

keys.label: Hunters only
keys.explain: When on, only Hunters may use the Beastmaster. Turn it off to let every class tame pets.

keys.label: Allowed classes
keys.explain: Comma-separated class ids allowed to adopt pets (0 = all classes). Only used when Hunters-only is off.

keys.label: Minimum level
keys.explain: Level a character must reach before adopting a pet (0 = no requirement).

keys.note: add 601026 to silence a harmless gossip warning
keys.label: Custom creature ids
keys.explain: The list of custom creatures with gossip dialogues hardcoded in core, divided by "," without spaces. It is implied that you do not use for these NPC dialogs data from "gossip_menu" table. Server will skip these IDs during the definitions validation process.
